name: Alterac Mountains
summary: In the Alterac Mountains, ruined settlements and bandits claim the slopes above Hillsbrad’s pastures. Once the heart of a proud human kingdom, the highlands now offer travelers little safety.

sections.title: A Fallen Realm
sections.body: The Alterac highlands once held a sovereign human nation, one of seven kingdoms born from ancient Arathor. During the Second War, King Aiden Perenolde secretly made a pact with the Old Horde. He let orcish forces cross the peaks in return for his kingdom’s safety. The Alliance of Lordaeron uncovered the betrayal and deposed him. Martial law and territorial disputes left the region divided.

sections.title: Wilderness and Bandits
sections.body: The Third War’s devastation left the mountains lawless. Disinherited nobles formed the Syndicate, which works from Strahnbrad’s ruins and plots to reclaim its lost dominion through sabotage and assassination. Crushridge ogres hold the shattered capital. Gnolls roam the slopes, and the magical ruins around Dalaran lie shattered. Alterac’s passes remain among Lordaeron’s most perilous paths.

faq.q: What kingdom used to rule these mountains?
faq.answer: The human kingdom of Alterac ruled these mountains for generations after the Empire of Arathor splintered. Its capital stood among the highest peaks, commanding roads between Lordaeron, Dalaran, and the Arathi highlands. Alterac fell during the Second War.

During the Second War, King Aiden Perenolde betrayed the Alliance of Lordaeron by helping the Horde. When his treason came to light, Alliance armies crushed Alterac’s forces and deposed the crown. Without a legitimate ruler, and after the Third War’s devastation, the nation collapsed into rubble.

faq.q: Who are the Syndicate lurking in the hills?
aliases: why are there bandits in alterac
faq.answer: The Syndicate is an outlaw faction of former Alteraci nobles and their retainers. Led by Aliden Perenolde, its members employ brigands, assassins, and rogue mercenaries to destabilize the region. They hope to restore their kingdom through violence.

faq.q: What threats wander the snowy peaks?
faq.answer: Travelers on the slopes face brutal Crushridge ogres, packs of Highland gnolls, scavenging kobolds, and Syndicate brigands who patrol the passes.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the Alterac Mountains recall Perenolde’s treachery, which nearly doomed humanity during the Second War.
As a rogue, you find the mountain passes thick with Syndicate agents and hired cutthroats. These hills test your survival and skill at counter-espionage.
